editing.source:
import "@nx/visualizer"

type uitext = string
type Swatch = string
type Count = int

type Size =
  /// The smallest cup.
  | small
  /// The usual.
  | medium
  | large
  | custom { ounces:int }

type Drink = {
  name:string
  size:Size = medium
  iced:bool = false
  shots:Count = 1
  color?:Swatch
  label:uitext = "Drink"
  tags:string* = {}
}

type Counter = { count:int }
type Text = { content text:string }

visualizer Swatch = <ValueVisualizer format=color />

let total = 3

let latte =
  <Drink
    name="Latte"
    size=medium
    iced=false
    shots=2
    color="#5a3a22"
    label="Hot \"latte\""
    tags={ "warm" "milky" }
  />

let counter = <Counter count={total + 1} />

let note = <Text>Hello there</Text>

let ratio = 1.5
